description: Replace a custom collection’s name, source list, filters, and highlights. Read get_collection first and preserve desired settings: omitted filters, highlights and AI filter are cleared, matchingSourcesOnly becomes false, and columnWidth resets to null. In the server-managed Related news collection, sources only tune its existing streams and matchingSourcesOnly stays true. Automatically follows eligible sources, may consume invitations, and rebuilds the stored collection feed. An attached AI filter processes incoming posts and can use the account’s AI allowance.
